blocks.html: Total Addressable Market (TAM) is the total revenue opportunity available for a product or service if it achieved 100% market share within its defined target market.

TAM helps businesses estimate the maximum possible demand for their offering. It is commonly used for market sizing, strategic planning, investment decisions, and evaluating long-term growth potential.

items.html: Identifying the full target customer base
Estimating average annual revenue per customer
Multiplying customer volume by expected spend
Analyzing industry trends and demand driver
Segmenting markets by geography or vertical
Refining estimates using bottom-up or top-down methods

blocks.html: Companies use TAM to understand scale and prioritize expansion opportunities.
A SaaS company estimates 50,000 target businesses globally, each worth $10,000 annually, resulting in a TAM of $500 million.
Total Addressable Market (TAM) measures the full revenue opportunity available if a business captured its entire target market.
Understand your true market potential. MarketJoy helps businesses evaluate TAM to identify growth opportunities and smarter go-to-market strategies.
